title.en: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred and Thirty-Two, by Enlarging the Powers, Functions and Duties of the Philippine Sugar Institute, Providing for the Financing Thereof, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred and Thirty-Two, by Enlarging the Powers, Functions and Duties of the Philippine Sugar Institute, Providing for the Financing Thereof, and for Other Purposes

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1328_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 2、3 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en: Section two of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred and thirty-two is hereby amended to read as follows:
Section three of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred and thirty-two is hereby amended to read as follows:

A section is hereby inserted between sections sixteen and seventeen of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred and thirty-two, to be known as section sixteen-A, to read as follows:
Section 16- A. The proceeds of all collections made under Commonwealth Act Numbered Five hundred and sixty-seven, shall constitute a special fund and accrue to the Sugar Research and Stabilization Fund which shall likewise be available for the maintenance, operation and use of the Philippine Sugar Institute."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
